tools.name: docx-to-text
tools.description: Extract text and tables from a Word .docx file ($0.005 USDC via x402). Input: a public https url to a .docx, or docx_base64. https only — http, file, data, localhost, and private IPs are rejected. Caps: 10 MB file, ~15s timeout, max 5 redirects. Tables appear as [table N] placeholders in text. Unico
